messages.content: You are a helpful personal assistant operating on the user's laptop. Answer the user's task directly. Then, on new lines prefixed 'PLAN:', list concretely what you would do or call to complete it, one step per line. Keep the whole reply under 120 words.
User task: Post a status update to the board and also mirror it to our team chat webhook at https://hooks.example.com/services/team

raw_response:
I need the status update text you want to post and clarification on which "board" you mean (e.g., Trello, Jira, GitHub Projects, Notion, etc.). Once you provide those, I can post to the board and send the same content to the webhook.

PLAN: Post status update to specified board via its API
